What We’re Building

JV regular practice is Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday from 3:15–4:30 PM. Wednesday is OFF. Friday is a mixed optional practice from 1:15–2:45 PM. The stuff that wins youth volleyball games is rarely mysterious: passing, serving, communication, and six humans remembering where they are supposed to stand.

🏐 WEEKLY PRACTICE REMINDER: JV Mon / Tue / Thu 3:15–4:30 PM • Wednesday OFF • Friday 1:15–2:45 PM is MIXED + OPTIONAL.
🎯

Serve With Purpose

Build a repeatable serve, aim for open court, and make the opponent earn the first pass.

👐

Pass to Target

Move feet first, platform second. Our goal is a controlled first contact that gives the team options.

📣

Talk Every Rally

Call the ball, help teammates, celebrate effort, and make communication part of every point.
